d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Cooker me Rasgulla banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye bhai super soft aur spongy bante hai, bengali rasgulle hum log ghar me easily bana sakte hai pressure cooker me, important tips aur tricks bhi share karunga, aap bhi try kijiega!
Ingredients:
Rasgulla Cooker Me Banane ke lie:
Cow Milk - 5 Packet
Lemon Juice - 1 tbsp or 1 tsp Nimbu Sat
Water to mix with Nimbu
Suji - 1 tsp
Cheeni / Sugar - 2 cups
